headline: Pop Mart Revenue Slumps as Labubu Collectible Hype Fades
summary: Parent company Pop Mart's revenue has fallen as consumer appetite for the quirky collectible Labubu monsters wanes.
why: Pop Mart is a major toy designer and retailer known for popularizing blind-box collectibles, making consumer demand trends critical for its financial performance.

impacts.name: Pop Mart
impacts.why: Falling revenue directly impacts the company's financial results and equity valuation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
